run_contact_graspnet_server: run the contact graspnet ROS node with a checkpoint directory to predict 6-DoF grasps from point clouds
run_inference_with_local_regions: run the contact graspnet server with local region cropping enabled to focus on segmented objects
run_inference_with_grasp_filtering: run the contact graspnet server with grasp filtering to assign contacts according to segmentation map
run_inference_for_specific_segmap_id: run the contact graspnet server to return grasps only for a specified segmentation map object ID
run_inference_with_multiple_forward_pass: run the contact graspnet server with multiple forward passes to discover more potential contact points
